privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.body: This Privacy Policy describes how Head Over Feels collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you visit or make a purchase from our store.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.body: By visiting our site and/or purchasing something from us, you engage in our Service and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.body: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery on unworn items with tags attached. Drop releases are final sale.

shippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy
shippingPolicy.body: Orders ship from Los Angeles within 2 business days. Domestic orders over $150 ship free.
